question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Mess around"?
options: To spend time without any purpose or plan just in a playful way
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: समय बिताना (बिना किसी विशेष उद्देश्य के या मजाक में)
English Meaning: To spend time without any purpose or plan just in a playful way
📝 Sentence Example:"They mess around at the park annoying the elderly people."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Mess (गड़बड़) + Around (चारों तरफ) -> बिना किसी काम के इधर-उधर टाइम पास करना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Mess up"?
options: To make a mistake / To make something disorderly or untidy
To defeat by a narrow margin
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: गलती करना / अस्त-व्यस्त करना
English Meaning: To make a mistake / To make something disorderly or untidy
📝 Sentence Example:"They messed up and suffered huge loss. / They messed up my beautiful carpet."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Mess (गंदगी) -> सब कुछ गड़बड़ (Mess) कर देना या गलती कर देना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Mess with"?
options: To alter something improperly, to deceive or confuse someone
To write something so that you don't forget it
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: अस्त-व्यस्त करना/उलझा देना
English Meaning: To alter something improperly, to deceive or confuse someone
📝 Sentence Example:"Don't mess with the sitting arrangement. / Don't try to mess with me."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Mess + With -> किसी के 'साथ' फालतू पंगा लेना या चीज़ों से छेड़छाड़ करना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Move in"?
options: To enter a new house/ place business
To suffer for making some mistake
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: नये घर/ऑफिस में प्रवेश करना
English Meaning: To enter a new house/ place business
📝 Sentence Example:"I moved in but found the house not safe."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Move + In -> नए घर के 'अंदर' (In) शिफ्ट (Move) होना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Move on"?
options: To concentrate one's emotions or attention on other matter in recovering from a setback
To write something so that you don't forget
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: आगे बढ़ना (पुरानी बुरी यादें व परेशानियों को भुला कर)
English Meaning: To concentrate one's emotions or attention on other matter in recovering from a setback or difficulty.
📝 Sentence Example:"Control your emotions and move on in life."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Move + On -> पुरानी बातें छोड़ कर ज़िंदगी में 'आगे बढ़ना' (Move on)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Move out"?
options: To defeat by a narrow margin
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: रहने का स्थान छोड़ देना
English Meaning: To leave a house
📝 Sentence Example:"I moved out of the government allotted flat."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Move + Out -> घर से अपना सामान लेकर 'बाहर' (Out) निकल जाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Nose out"?
options: To defeat by a narrow margin, to move cautiously out of some place
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: बहुत कम अंतर से हराना, सावधानी से निकलना
English Meaning: To defeat by a narrow margin, to move cautiously out of some place
📝 Sentence Example:"She nosed out her competitor. / She nosed out of her room while the building was shaking..."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Nose -> सिर्फ़ एक 'नाक' (Nose) के फासले से जीत जाना या चुपके से निकलना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Note down"?
options: To make something appear less important
To write something so that you don't forget it
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: लिखना (याद रखने हेतु)
English Meaning: To write something so that you don't forget it
📝 Sentence Example:"Please note down the important points."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Note -> कॉपी में 'नोट' (Note) कर लेना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Occur to"?
options: To suffer for making some mistake
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: ध्यान में आना
English Meaning: To come to mind
📝 Sentence Example:"It suddenly occurred to me that my purse was missing."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Occur -> अचानक दिमाग में कोई बात घटित होना (Occur)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Part from"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: छोड़ देना (व्यक्ति को)
English Meaning: To separate from someone.
📝 Sentence Example:"I cannot part from my son."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Part (अलग) + From -> किसी 'इंसान' से अलग होना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Part with"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: छोड़ देना (वस्तु को)
English Meaning: To separate from something.
📝 Sentence Example:"I cannot part with my books."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Part + With -> अपनी किसी 'चीज़/वस्तु' (With) से अलग होना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Pass away"?
options: To make something appear less important
To defeat by a narrow margin
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: मर जाना
English Meaning: To die
📝 Sentence Example:"He passed away in sleep."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Pass + Away -> दुनिया से 'गुज़र' (Pass) कर दूर (Away) चले जाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Pay for"?
options: To suffer for making some mistake
To write something so that you don't forget
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: गलती का हर्जाना भरना
English Meaning: To suffer for making some mistake.
📝 Sentence Example:"We have to pay for our sins."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Pay -> अपने किए की 'कीमत चुकाना' (Pay)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Play at"?
options: To do without interest or half-heartedly
To make someone experience something unpleasant
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: बिना रूचि के कोई काम करना
English Meaning: To do without interest or half-heartedly.
📝 Sentence Example:"She is just playing at her husband's business."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Play -> काम को सीरियसली ना लेकर बस 'खेल' (Play) की तरह करना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Play down"?
options: To make something appear less important, to belittle
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: किसी बात के महत्व को कम करके आंकना
English Meaning: To make something appear less important, to belittle
📝 Sentence Example:"He played down my efforts."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Play + Down -> किसी की मेहनत या बात को 'नीचे' (Down) दिखाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Play on"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: का लाभ उठाना
English Meaning: To take advantage of
📝 Sentence Example:"He played on her emotions."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Play + On -> किसी की भावनाओं पर 'खेलना' (फायदा उठाना)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Put aside"?
options: To stop using until later/ to disregard
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: भविष्य के लिए बचाकर रखना/ उपेक्षा करना
English Meaning: To stop using until later/ to disregard.
📝 Sentence Example:"Put aside some money for the rains days."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Put + Aside -> थोड़े पैसे किनारे (Aside) रख देना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Put down"?
options: To suffer for making some mistake
To become used up, be exhausted
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: दमन करना/ निंदा करना
English Meaning: To suppress/to criticize
📝 Sentence Example:"Never put down your friends in public."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Put + Down -> किसी को बातों से 'नीचे गिराना' (Down) या बेइज्ज़त करना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Put off"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: स्थगित करना/ विकर्षित करना
English Meaning: To postpone/ to repel
📝 Sentence Example:"The meeting was put off due to heavy rain. / The smell of tobacco puts her off."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Put + Off -> मूड 'ऑफ' कर देना या काम को कल पर टाल देना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Put on"?
options: to look at/ examine especially quickly
To make something appear less important
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: ग्रहण करना/पहनना
English Meaning: Assume/ to clothe oneself
📝 Sentence Example:"Put on your sweater."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Put + On -> कपड़े शरीर के 'ऊपर' (On) चढ़ाना (पहनना)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Put out"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: बुझा देना
English Meaning: To extinguish
📝 Sentence Example:"Put out the fire."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Put + Out -> आग को 'बाहर' (Out) निकाल कर बुझा देना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Put through"?
options: To make someone experience something unpleasant
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: किसी को मुसीबत या परेशानी में डालना
English Meaning: To make someone experience something unpleasant
📝 Sentence Example:"He put me through many problems."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Put + Through -> किसी को मुश्किलों के 'आर-पार' (Through) धकेलना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Put up"?
options: To reserve for a specific use
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: ठहरना
English Meaning: To stay
📝 Sentence Example:"Where are you putting up in Delhi?"
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Put + Up -> अपना बोरिया बिस्तर कहीं 'रखकर' (Put) वहां रुकना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Put up"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: निर्माण करना
English Meaning: To erect or built
📝 Sentence Example:"We will put up a tent at night."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Put + Up -> टेंट को ज़मीन से 'ऊपर' (Up) खड़ा करना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Put together"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: बनाना
English Meaning: To construct or create
📝 Sentence Example:"We need to put together the models for our physics assignments."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Put + Together -> अलग-अलग हिस्सों को 'एक साथ' (Together) जोड़कर बनाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Pay-off"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: फलदायक होना
English Meaning: to be successful
📝 Sentence Example:"Hard work pays off."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Pay + Off -> तुम्हारी मेहनत ने आख़िरकार फल (Pay) दे दिया।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Run down"?
options: To make someone experience something unpleasant
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: कमजोर होना/हरा देना/ आलोचना करना
English Meaning: become weak/to criticise
📝 Sentence Example:"(i) Do not run down your spouse in public. (ii) He looks run down."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Run + Down -> बैटरी का Run down होना मतलब कमज़ोर पड़ना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Run into"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: सामना होना/ अचानक मुलाकात करना
English Meaning: To face/to meet by chance
📝 Sentence Example:"I ran into my childhood friend in the market."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Run + Into -> भागते-भागते अचानक किसी से 'टकरा' (Into) जाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Run off"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: भाग जाना
English Meaning: To run away
📝 Sentence Example:"He ran off with his master's money."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Run + Off -> पैसे लेकर भाग (Run) जाना (रफूचक्कर होना)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Run out"?
options: To become used up, be exhausted
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: खत्म होना
English Meaning: To become used up, be exhausted
📝 Sentence Example:"He ran out of money while he was in the U.S."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Run + Out -> क्रिकेट में बैट्समैन रन आउट होता है (खेल खत्म), वैसे ही राशन का खत्म होना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Run over"?
options: To defend or challenge, confront fearlessly
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: कुचल जाना
English Meaning: to crush beneath
📝 Sentence Example:"The old man was run over by a speeding bus."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Run + Over -> गाड़ी का किसी के 'ऊपर' (Over) से गुज़र जाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Run short of"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: कम पड़ जाना
English Meaning: exhaust
📝 Sentence Example:"We ran short of money at the mall."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Short -> किसी चीज़ का Short (कम) पड़ जाना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Run through"?
options: to look at/ examine especially quickly
To resign from a high post
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: सरसरी निगाह डालना
English Meaning: to look at/ examine especially quickly
📝 Sentence Example:"Please run through the important points."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Run + Through -> पन्नों के बीच से 'तेज़ी से भागना' (जल्दी-जल्दी पढ़ना)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "See through"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: सच्चाई भांप जाना
English Meaning: To realise the truth
📝 Sentence Example:"I saw through his evil intention."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:See + Through -> झूठ के परदे के 'आर-पार' (Through) सच्चाई देख लेना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "See to"?
options: To become used up, be exhausted
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: निपटाना
English Meaning: To attend
📝 Sentence Example:"The work has to be completed on time. Please see to it."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:See + To -> 'ज़रा इसे देखना' (काम को निपटाना)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "See off"?
options: To resemble a close or an older relative
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: विदा लेना
English Meaning: To take leave of
📝 Sentence Example:"I went to the station to see off my friends."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:See + Off -> स्टेशन पर जाकर किसी को 'अलविदा' कहना (See off)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Send for"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: बुलावा भेजना
English Meaning: To call, summon
📝 Sentence Example:"Please, send for a doctor."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Send + For -> किसी को बुलाने 'के लिए' (For) सन्देश 'भेजना' (Send)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Set about"?
options: to look at/ examine especially quickly
To remove, to leave the ground
To take responsibility for or control of
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: प्रारंभ करना (किसी कार्य को)
English Meaning: To initiate
📝 Sentence Example:"He set about solving the problems one by one."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Set -> किसी काम में अपना माइंड Set करके उसे शुरू करना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Set apart"?
options: To reserve for a specific use
Think one to be someone else
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: आरक्षित करना
English Meaning: To reserve for a specific use
📝 Sentence Example:"Some fund was set apart for public welfare."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Set + Apart -> किसी चीज़ को 'अलग' (Apart) करके रख देना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Set aside"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: रद्द करना
English Meaning: To reject or discard
📝 Sentence Example:"The order of the lower court was set aside by the High Court."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Set + Aside -> पुराने आर्डर को 'किनारे' (Aside) करके रद्द कर देना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Set forth"?
options: To present for consideration, to express in words
To deal with (a topic) in passing
To improve by making minor correction
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: विचार हेतु रखना, शब्दों में बताना
English Meaning: To present for consideration, to express in words
📝 Sentence Example:"Set forth your proposal before the committee."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Set + Forth -> अपने विचार 'आगे' (Forth) रखना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Set in"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: शुरू होना
English Meaning: To begin to happen
📝 Sentence Example:"Problems soon set in and all felt uneasy."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Set + In -> मौसम या परेशानी का 'अंदर' आकर जम जाना (शुरू होना)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Set off"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: शुरू करना/ फट जाना
English Meaning: To occur, to explode
📝 Sentence Example:"The bombs set off ripping apart the bus. / We set off for Manali in the morning."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Set + Off -> यात्रा शुरू करना या बम का फटना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Set up"?
options: To reserve for a specific use
To come to a meeting or to form a crowd
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: स्थापित करना
English Meaning: To establish
📝 Sentence Example:"He set up a new business."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Set + Up -> बिज़नेस का Setup (स्थापना) करना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Set upon"?
options: To serve the needs of, visit
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: उग्रता के साथ आक्रमण कर देना
English Meaning: To attack violently
📝 Sentence Example:"Our army set upon the intruders."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Set + Upon -> पूरी ताक़त से दुश्मन के 'ऊपर' (Upon) टूट पड़ना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Shoot down"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: हरा देना, निराश करना
English Meaning: To defeat, disappoint
📝 Sentence Example:"He shot down his opponent."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Shoot + Down -> गोली मारकर या तर्कों से 'नीचे' (Down) गिरा देना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Shoot up"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: तेजी से बढ़ना
English Meaning: To grow rapidly
📝 Sentence Example:"Prices shoot up during inflation."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Shoot + Up -> रॉकेट की तरह 'ऊपर' (Up) भागना (दाम बढ़ना)।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Sit on"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: दबा देना/ टालते रहना
English Meaning: To suppress or postpone
📝 Sentence Example:"The court sat on the case for years."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Sit + On -> किसी फाइल के 'ऊपर बैठ' (Sit on) जाना ताकि काम आगे ना बढ़े।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Smart under"?
options: To become used up, be exhausted
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: पीड़ित होना
English Meaning: To be afflicted with
📝 Sentence Example:"He smarted under the blow of the lash."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Smart (दर्द) + Under -> कोड़े की मार के 'नीचे' (Under) दर्द (Smart) से तड़पना।

question: What is the meaning of the phrasal verb "Smile on"?
solution:
हिंदी अर्थ: प्रसन्न होना
English Meaning: To bless
📝 Sentence Example:"Fate smiled on him."
💡 धांसू देसी Trick:Smile + On -> किस्मत का आप 'पर' (On) मेहरबान होकर 'मुस्कुराना'।
